title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 24: the twenty-four divisions of the priests chosen by lot and the rest of the sons of Levi.

questions.text: Why did Eleazar and Ithamar execute the priest's office?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:2 says Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children, so Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

answers.text: Nadab and Abihu had become the king's judges
Nadab and Abihu died childless before their father
Nadab and Abihu had left for the land of Moab
Nadab and Abihu had refused to serve the king

questions.text: Ahimelech, who helped David divide the priests, was of the sons of whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:3 says Zadok was of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar.

questions.text: How many heads of fathers' houses were there of the sons of Ithamar?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:4 says there were sixteen of the sons of Eleazar and eight of the sons of Ithamar.

questions.text: How were the priests divided impartially?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:5 says they were divided impartially by drawing lots.

answers.text: By a vote of the elders

questions.text: Who wrote the divisions down in the presence of the king and the princes?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:6 says Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them.

questions.text: To whom did the first lot come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:7 says the first lot came out to Jehoiarib.

questions.text: To whom did the twenty-fourth lot come out?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:18 says the twenty-fourth lot came out to Maaziah.

questions.text: According to whose ordinance did the priests come into Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:19 says they came according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh had commanded him.

questions.text: What does the text say about Eleazar, the son of Mahli?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:28 says that of Mahli there was Eleazar, who had no sons.

answers.text: He was a doorkeeper at the east gate

questions.text: In whose presence did the rest of the Levites cast lots, as the sons of Aaron had?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:31 says they cast lots in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' households.

answers.text: Saul the king, Samuel, and Abner
David the king, Zadok, and Ahimelech
Solomon the king, Nathan, and Gad
